propositions: _fold_heads currently merges bundle heads into the worktree HEAD, making the heal result depend on the checked-out branch, forcing _require_tracker_on_ref to refuse heals when the ref is not checked out
The fold must instead merge into refs/heads/<ref> directly using git merge-tree and commit-tree, independent of which branch is checked out
The published ref must be moved conditionally: git update-ref when the ref is not checked out, git reset --hard when it is, to keep index and worktree consistent
A narrow dirty-worktree refusal must replace the blanket _require_tracker_on_ref guard, early before any bundle download
The fold must preserve the merge=ours driver policy for .bridge_state/* conflicts via merge-tree --write-tree, proven by a new regression test
Trackers with side branches checked out or detached HEAD must heal successfully without moving the checked-out branch or worktree
